div.head: Ine 6.4
div.ab: ⁊ þeah hit sy gefohten on middan felda, CXX scll' to wite sy agifen.
⁊ þeah hit sie on middum felda gefohten, CXX scill. to wite sie agifen.
Et licet sit in mediis campis dimicatum, centum uiginti sol. wite reddantur.
⁊ þeah hit sie on middum felda gefohten cxx sciƚƚ to wite sie agifen.
And even if the fight takes place in an open field, 120 shillings shall be paid as fine.
And even if it [the fight] takes place in the open, a fine of 120 shillings shall be paid.
And even if the fighting is in the midst of the open country, 120 shillings is to be given as a fine.
Und wenn selbst [nur] mitten auf dem Felde gefochten worden ist, werde [dem König doch] 120 [30] Schill. zur Strafe gegeben.
And even if the fighting has taken place [only] in the middle of the open field, let 120 [30] shillings [nevertheless] be given [to the king] as a fine.
